close_reason: Implemented push_subscription_update(&Id, &PushSubscriptionPatch) and push_subscription_destroy(&[Id]) in crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/misc.rs. Both issue PushSubscription/set without an accountId (RFC 8620 §7.2 — PushSubscriptions are not account-scoped). Added PushSubscriptionPatch struct exposing the patchable RFC 8620 §7.2 properties (verificationCode, expires, types) plus the JMAP Chat Push chatPush extension; url/keys/deviceClientId are correctly omitted per the immutability rule. Capability declaration: USING_CHAT_PUSH only when the patch touches chatPush, USING_CORE otherwise. Defence-in-depth: empty-Id, empty-ids, types/clear_types mutual exclusion, chat_push/clear_chat_push mutual exclusion, and duplicate-accountId guards. Updated push_subscription_create doc to cross-reference the new methods. cargo fmt/clippy/test --workspace all green.
